method: Outer rings of the zone's land parts from the Natural Earth admin-1 regions listed in compute-centroids.ts, Douglas-Peucker 0.02 degrees, rounded to 0.01 degrees, parts under 0.005 square degrees dropped. Only zones in countries with several zones. Approximate; for placing points in a zone.
source: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1 states/provinces, release v5.1.2 (public domain)
